title: COMMANDS — import, campaign-change and price-history work
summary: Drill-down of “Commands”: three distinct responsibilities with their own decisions. Composition stages, decisions and data transformations only; not a call stack or observed runtime behaviour.

Lines 26-70: ignore older ValidFrom than last valid item; upsert price (ValidTo=max); add missing N-MONTERX price-list-table rows per warehouse.
Lines 23-60: Monter-only (non-transient error otherwise); reject events older than stored LastModifiedUtc; upsert price; add N-MONTERX table row.
Lines 34-57: diff saved vs current item campaigns, publish ItemCampaignsChanged batch, then save new baseline.
Lines 31-41: lowest-price snapshot scoped by configured Monter franchise warehouse -> ERP data source.

Before-price design: daily lowest-price snapshot via timer→queue; schedule 07:00/13:00/19:00; campaign before-price after each snapshot; purge >6 months via separate timer; Outlet hardcoded campaign id; API returns before price in campaign price part. Design intent matching timer→queue handlers — not a binding of exact cron expressions beyond this page.

nodes.label: External price-list import
nodes.responsibility: Nexstep/VisionPoint prices and campaigns into the N-MONTERX price-list table. Decisions: stale-event rejection (Nexstep by ValidFrom, VisionPoint by LastModifiedUtc); VisionPoint accepted for Monter only; ensures warehouse rows in the price-list table.

nodes.label: Campaign change detection
nodes.responsibility: Diffs stored item-campaign baseline against current campaigns, publishes ItemCampaignsChanged (added/removed), then saves the new baseline; admin path republishes all.
